newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai interbank rate steady, baht eases late.
newsitem.headline: Thai interbank rate steady, baht eases late.

text.p: The Thai overnight interbank rate was steady at 13.75-14.00 percent in late trade on Wednesday compared with 14.00 percent earlier and 13.50-14.00 late on Tuesday amid tight market liquidity, dealers said.
"The market was very quiet today with the interbank rate moving in very narrow range," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
Dealers expect the interbank rate to ease slightly tomorrow as some banks have begun to bring in foreign funds.
The baht eased to 25.360-25.365 to the dollar from 25.357-25.360 early on the rising dollar abroad, dealers said.
"The dollar rose slightly against the majors abroad since late morning. But buying interest in the dollar remained limited due to strong demand for baht," one currency dealer said.
The one-month dollar/baht swap premium was at 10.50-11.30 satangs per dollar late compared with 10.00-11.00 earlier and 11.00-11.50 late on Tuesday.
The Bank of Thailand fixed the mid-rate at 25.36 to the dollar against 25.38 on Tuesday.
